$comment: In-house forge eval: typical SO-101 add-ons with automatic graders (backend/forge/eval/graders.py). Mount ids come from forge/mounts/so101.json, which has three interfaces today (gripper_cam_face, gripper_outer_face, forearm_clamp). Tasks that would ideally sit elsewhere (upper arm, base, moving jaw) use the closest existing interface; the request text says so, so a model is not graded on a mount we cannot simulate.

tasks.request: SO-101 with a small flashlight on the gripper: a holder for a 10 mm white LED aimed at the jaw tips, powered from USB 5 V.
A bracket for a small 32 x 32 mm USB camera board (2x M2 holes, 28 mm pitch) on the SO-101 wrist, looking at the jaw tips.
A clip that guides the servo cable along the SO-101 forearm (use the forearm band clamp area), for a 3-wire cable up to 4 mm thick.
A small holder for a 6 mm hex key / screwdriver that rides on the SO-101 forearm band clamp (the base has no mount point yet).
A clamp on the SO-101 forearm that holds an 8 mm carbon rod as a short mast for a phone or camera (rod not printed).
A simple fingertip pad for the fixed jaw of the SO-101 (outer face, attached with double-sided tape), with a ribbed grip surface.
